# Kitchener Furnace Repair

> Kitchener Furnace Repair is a local HVAC company serving Kitchener, Waterloo Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 590-5222  |  Email: contact@kitchenerfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://kitchenerfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: Kitchener, Cambridge, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
